Culture.name: Patrick Stewart

perspectives.title: Patrick Stewart
perspectives.summary: Patrick Stewart was a great human being

representative_posts.author: funsizela.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was a wonderful human being. He taught us to see the humanity in others, to cherish time, to laugh with ease, and follow the fucking prime directive. Cheers to an amazingly great life lived by an amazingly great human being.

representative_posts.author: ella-ca.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart… much respect for a kind man.

representative_posts.author: johanlenaerts.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: RIP Patrick Stewart. You will forever be an inspiration to many across the globe, both in character and out.

representative_posts.author: urokialreadyknow.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart passed away at the age of 86. Here are just a few of his roles... #rip

representative_posts.author: peterallison.net
representative_posts.text: I was extremely saddened when I heard about the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart. I never met him, but those I spoke to who did, always spoke with warmth and admiration. He was one of those few people who always stood by his principles, regardless of wealth or fame. He was one of the good ones...

representative_posts.author: lacymb.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: For , my small contribution to our collective mourning for Patrick Stewart, a legend both onscreen and off who made us believe that intelligence and empathy really could save the world.

representative_posts.author: donnadel.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Sir Patrick Stewart was a seriously decent human being. He has left a big hole in the world, not easily filled.

representative_posts.author: vecosi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The world has lost a lot of light this year and this is a tough one. I've grown up watching Patrick Stewart through his many lives as characters like Charles Xavier and Jean-Luc Picard. I owe a lot of my love of the creative arts to him.

representative_posts.author: audieklotz.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Never knew much about Patrick Stewart beyond the stardom and am learning only now about his other career of working to protect women and children from domestic violence ❤️‍🩹

representative_posts.author: kq5.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In my 2 years on BS, today's the 1st time I've seen the top 2 trending topics the same, "Patrick Stewart dies". He was important, not just as a TV character who portrayed a fine example of humanity, but in real life he was an advocate for the downtrodden; women abused by men. A true hero. 💔🖖

representative_posts.author: alapidis.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The outpouring of love, memories and sadness, for the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart on Bluesky warms my heart.

representative_posts.author: snakedoc-blane.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Retweet • Remembering this unforgettable moment with a true legend, whose talent and presence reached far beyond the stars ✨ Rest In Peace, Sir Patrick Stewart ❤️

representative_posts.author: philipfrankenfeld.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart was resonant in every role he played. Stage. Film. TV.

representative_posts.author: irl-lucye.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Actual tears at the news of Patrick Stewart's passing. Such charisma, warmth and talent. I just loved him.

representative_posts.author: shelfnerds.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Through his portrayal of Picard, Sir Patrick Stewart showed us how to retain our humanity and dignity as we weather the “heart-ache and the thousand natural shocks/that flesh is heir to.”

representative_posts.author: dankmccoy.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I wrote Sir Patrick Stewart into this Daily Show piece on a whim, and he actually agreed to it. He never even looked mildly perturbed at the amount of time he had to stand around in a foil-covered box. RIP to a man who was as good a sport as he was an actor.

representative_posts.author: gnarleth.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This one hurts. Thank you, Sir Patrick Stewart, for telling the stories that inspired us to boldly go where we never thought we could 🫡

representative_posts.author: katherinecatmull.com
representative_posts.text: i am sad for patrick stewart, a superb actor and also marvelously funny. his bit in Extras makes me laugh every time & i think of it whenever i read or watch something that is clearly the author’s underprocesed fantasy

representative_posts.author: brezwrites.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I never interviewed Patrick Stewart, sadly, but I want to join the outpouring of affection for him. Once, at an award season party at the San Vicente Bungalows I saw him grab onto a tree branch and start doing pull-ups. This was only a few years ago. He was formidable to the end.

representative_posts.author: ked1994.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: An accurate depiction of how I'm feeling in response to the news of Patrick Stewart's passing

representative_posts.author: henryd43.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's been a real struggle to try and process the fact that such a great talent is gone. This one really stings. Rest in Peace Sir Patrick Stewart...

representative_posts.author: jeremiahlee.com
representative_posts.text: 💔 Patrick Stewart “Make it so.” #RIP #PatrickStewart

representative_posts.author: eamonfitzpatrick.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This anecdote by Patrick Stewart on the Graham Norton show, is absolutely hilarious😂

representative_posts.author: empressofrobots.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: jfc bluesky. As if today couldn't get any worse, Patrick Stewart died AGAIN?!?!

representative_posts.author: monicabyrne13.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: I haven’t seen anyone post this one yet….Patrick Stewart had the best cameo in one of my favorite films of all time (L.A. Story).

representative_posts.author: hermitsunited.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: In 2011, Patrick Stewart and his son Daniel appeared together at WizardWorld Chicago, and I was lucky enough to be there. The moderator asked him what he wanted to be remembered for, and he said "I want to be remembered for being funny, but that's not going to happen." RIP our hilarious captain.

representative_posts.author: stringcheese24.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: “I rather believe that time is a companion who goes with us on the journey and reminds us to cherish every moment because it will never come again.” Rest peacefully, Sir Patrick Stewart (1940–2026). 🖖🏾 Live long and prosper. #SirPatrickStewart #StarTrek #JeanLucPicard #MakeItSo #ProfessorX #XMen

representative_posts.author: survivormarynu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The one and only Patrick Stewart. #RestInPeacePatrickStewart

representative_posts.text: man, didnt think the death of patrick stewart was gonna hit me like a train.

representative_posts.author: lauradi.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Patrick Stewart, universe? Really? What the hell is wrong with you?

perspectives.summary: Podcasts have issues with quality and value

representative_posts.author: momo.thingsabout.xyz
representative_posts.text: ruining the podcast on top of your life is crazy work

representative_posts.author: dalbak.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Don't waste your time listening to podcasts. Terrible way to take in information, listening to people babble and wander and drone and talk in circles and say they're gonna get to a point but when they do if they do it's kinda not the same point and you can't remember WTF it's all about anyway.

representative_posts.author: markantonyowen.com
representative_posts.text: There are already too many podcasts with nothing in particular to say or which have no unique or compelling perspective. So before you dig deep and lash out, ask yourself what YOUR podcast will bring to the table. If you can't answer this in a way that's at least equal to someone else's, just don't.

representative_posts.author: nabilsamandari.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: That last one is particularly easy to mess up. perspectives.summary: Smoking is no longer allowed in many public spaces

representative_posts.author: justbru.ce.it

perspectives.title: Data Centers Harm

representative_posts.author: dropthet.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Data centers are a tiny fraction of the energy problem. The idea that each private industrial business needs to create their own private energy generation system is itself ridiculous & a result of our de-growth mindset. For some reason it is now a liberal cause, to halt & even reverse growth.

representative_posts.author: justplainrude.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Wondering how to reduce the shouting about Data Centers? Read about it here:

representative_posts.author: byteseu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Behind the Headline: Data Centers and the Environment For all the attention they are currently receiving, data centers are not new. Over the last few decades, processing capacity, applications management, storage of digital information, and the like have moved …

representative_posts.author: mudakun.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The only way data centers get approved is by bribing politicians. Each one stands as a monument to corruption. Techbros are lawless deadbeats to the last, so good luck stopping the "temporary gas turbine generators" or the spike in electric rates once you are stuck with one.

representative_posts.author: joti.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How is it possible that anyone is considering yet more reliance on tech using AI and increasing data centres is a good idea with the way the world is now. A snip of an undersea cable, hacking, energy supply vulnerability not to mention attacks on data centres in a war scenario.

representative_posts.author: lexlyford.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: This is why we need more data centers. Who needs water anyway? Maybe we're just being greedy with our "thirst".

representative_posts.author: mattdragon.com
representative_posts.text: 🧵So it’s not a coincidence that there’s unifying, global, bipartisan opposition to data centers, particularly #AI data centers, happening at the same time.

representative_posts.author: itsliz2.bsky.social

representative_posts.author: argusdreamer.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: How do we ensure that data centers add to society more than they take from it? It's the most fair request of all time, it's based on fairness and expectation. If data centers aren't used to make the world a better place, why the hell are we building them?

representative_posts.author: theharveymilk.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Data centers connect to the grid, putting them under federal jurisdiction in many states (except Texas), and if anything goes sideways for these projects, the stranded costs will potentially be socialized among the ratepayers. Stop acting like this isn't a public issue

representative_posts.author: pklinkne.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Gotta figure out some way to pay for all those data centers

representative_posts.author: monkey-cousin.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: It's also insane that power companies have been covering these costs for data centers when they do nothing of the sort for residential.

representative_posts.author: electromit.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Having worked with certain people, I'm okay with living around a data center; they too, provide no real boon to society, are a drain on all resources within their reach and are CONSTANTLY making noise to the point of driving away anything within earshot!

representative_posts.author: saram853.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Large data centers are highly unpopular with voters, with approximately 63% opposing their construction within 10 miles of their homes. CNBC Forbes Trump SCRAMBLES In Unhinged Rant As Data Centers Get Worse For GOP

representative_posts.author: bingmanc.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Data centers are just as bad for a community as nuclear waste dumps.

representative_posts.author: thedoodle0503.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The reckless expansion of mega data centers has gone unchecked for too long. An immediate halt on approvals for new mega data centres is the circuit breaker we urgently need. Sign the petition to protect our water and energy, and force Big Tech to put people before profits:

representative_posts.text: It's been pretty profitable for the construction companies building data centers.

representative_posts.author: simongood.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: While pushes for more pipelines and water guzzling data centres.

representative_posts.author: yaenridesagain.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: And then there's this. People are aware of the threats of AI & data centres but we're up against capital as usual. Mamdani is interesting at the beginning of this.

representative_posts.author: samdrawngame.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: The fucked up a massive amount of land when they came to Finland and interpreted a "we'll think about it" as "yes, clear all the land you need" to try and force another data center for AI. And yet programmers of 10 years want me to think it's just a harmless tool for better programming.

representative_posts.text: Why is it an impressive engineering feat to put a million conputers next to each other? "Yet the delays have been accompanied by impressive engineering feats, including... the completion earlier this year of the first data centre to consume more than 1GW of power."

representative_posts.author: systemrogue.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Dear and I don't simply want data centers to pay their fair share, I want them destroyed and eradicated from our communities. I don't just want ALPRs removed from our communities, I want the companies behind them eradicated. Understand?

representative_posts.author: vmcntosh.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: Yep. In Canada I see the digital sovereignty arguments, but if the data center is owned by an American company the Cloud Act is in place and the Canadian location.. doesn’t mean much? It’s more a customer business preference, not actually solving an issue.

representative_posts.author: amias.net
representative_posts.text: most datacenters pre A.I were essentially self sufficient in that regard because its easier for continuity and the loads were not so high. i wish people would be clearer about the distinction between normal data centers and A.I ones , there is a high risk of creating a stupid anti tech backlash

representative_posts.author: ellenahzulu.bsky.social
representative_posts.text: You're not factoring in that these data centers & AIGen/LLMs are now considered part of the national security infrastructure grid, meaning they'll get gobs of taxpayer monies when the crash happens.

representative_posts.author: ens0.me
representative_posts.text: If you're concerned about data center construction, streaming video has fairly similar needs to AI in that regard, and we're just letting any random person throw up as much 4K footage as they want for free?
